handback.title: Settings ignore a comment after a value
handback.summary: A comment after a value in the settings file no longer becomes part of that value.
handback.user_story: A role named on a commented settings line runs on the agent the line names.

acceptance_criteria.text: A comment after a value in the settings file is no longer read as part of that value.
acceptance_criteria.words: The settings reader keeps an inline comment as part of a value, so a commented agent line names a wrong agent.
